spans.s: हृद् n. (this word has no forms for the first five cases; according to some, it is not a separate word but an optional substitute for हृदय) 1. The mind, the heart; 2. the chest, the bosom, हृदि क्षतो गोत्रमिदप्यमर्षणः R.iii.53.
हृद्-आवर्त m. a curl of hair on a horse’s chest.
हृद्-गत (I) a. conceived, designed, cherished.
हृद्-गत (II) n. meaning, intent.
हृद्-देश m. the region of the heart.
हृद्-रोग m. 1. heart-disease; 2. sorrow, grief, anguish; 3. love; 4. the sign Aquarius of the zodiac; (in this sense of Greek origin). See हृद्रोग.
हृद्-वंटक m. the stomach.
हृदिस्पृश् a. 1. dear, beloved; 2. beautiful, attractive; 3. touching the heart.

हृदय n. 1. The mind, the heart, अयोहृदयः प्रतिगर्जताम् R.ix.9, Megh.i.10, M.ii.1; 2. breast, chest, bosom, बाणभिन्नहृदया निपेतुषी R.xi.19; 3. the essence of any thing; 4. science, (e.g. अश्वहृदय ‘the science of horses’).
हृदय-आत्मन् m. a heron.
हृदय-आविध् a. heart-piercing, पंपामस्माकं हृदयाविधम् Bt.vi.73.
हृदय-विध्, -वेधिन् a. heart-piercing.
हृदय-ईश, -ईश्वर m. a husband.
हृदय-ईशा, -ईश्वरी f. 1. a wife; 2. mistress.
हृदय-ईश, -ईश्वर m. a husband.
हृदय-ईशा, -ईश्वरी f. 1. a wife; 2. mistress.
हृदय-कंप m. tremor of the heart.
हृदयंगम a. 1. heart-stirring, thrilling; 2. beautiful, attractive, pleasing, वल्लकी च हृदयंगमस्वना R.xix.13, K.S.ii.16; 3. appropriate, apposite; 4. dear, beloved, क्व नु ते हृदयंगमः सखा K.S.iv.24.
हृदय-चौर m. who steals the heart or affections.
हृदय-च्छिद् a. heart-breaking, heart-rending.
हृदय-विध्, -वेधिन् a. heart-piercing.
हृदय-वृत्ति f. disposition of the heart.
हृदय-स्थ a. cherished in the heart, being in the heart.
हृदय-स्थान n. the breast, the bosom.
हृदयालु a. Good-hearted, tender-hearted.
हृदिक m. Name of a Yādava king.
हृदिक-आत्मज m. an epithet of Kṛtavarman.
हृद्य a. (f. द्या) 1. Pleasant, agreeable, savoury, Bg.xvii.8; 2. affectionate, kind; 3. dear to the heart, cherished, desired.
हृद्य a. (f. द्या) 1. Pleasant, agreeable, savoury, Bg.xvii.8; 2. affectionate, kind; 3. dear to the heart, cherished, desired.
हृद्य-गंधा f. a kind of jasmine.
हृदयिन् a. (f. नी) Good-hearted, tender-hearted.
हृदयिन् a. (f. नी) Good-hearted, tender-hearted.
हृदयिक a. (f. का) Good-hearted, tender-hearted.
हृदयिक a. (f. का) Good-hearted, tender-hearted.
